title: Paul Presses On to Know Christ
summary_text: Paul warns against confidence in the flesh and says true circumcision belongs to those who worship by God's Spirit. He counts his former gains as loss beside knowing Christ, seeking righteousness through faith rather than the law. He wants to share Christ's sufferings and know the power of His resurrection. Though he has not reached his goal, Paul presses toward God's heavenly calling and urges others to follow his example. He contrasts enemies of the cross, who face destruction, with believers awaiting their Savior, who will make their bodies like His glorious body.
